column1: # The verdict `mobix-core` reaches on every committed corpus file
# reader in `tools/mobix-cli/` must reach too. `clean` means the file opens as a document (the archive
# and its pages) and its `assets/` rules hold; `refused` means it must not be accepted.
# `CorpusVerdictsTest` (`mobix-core`) recomputes this table and fails when a rule moves on one side

column2: so a change here is a decision rather than a stale list. `scripts/check-mobix-cli.py` compares
and the `cli` job in `.github/workflows/build.yml` runs that script. Licence:
